reason: I've never heard of this store and I'd screenshot that cloud pendant into Google Lens and find the same thing on Amazon or AliExpress for less. For $360 I'm not ordering from an unknown shop on photos alone.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and a no-name store with a 6 week wait and return shipping on me if I change my mind is too much risk for a fixture that has to look right in a guest-facing unit.
would_change_my_mind: Real customer photos and reviews from a source I trust, plus a paid sample or swatch of the paper and a free return even if I just change my mind.
